column4: chunky outlined ledges, round climber with a red scarf, sky that changes by zone, gold rest floors, red bumpers; the side bar marks your best height and this climb's top, and the best time sits in its own box rather than on the bar
no reference was named and none was used
2D side view in a tall 9:16 window, the camera following the climber with more view above
every word is Sorani drawn right to left with Western digits; whether the Kurdish reads well was not judged
ten zones laid out ledge by ledge, 123 ledges and 11 gold floors; only the first two ledges were climbed in a run, the rest were checked by arithmetic on gap and rise
a fall lands on the highest ledge under your feet; every zone ends in a full-width gold floor
coyote time, a remembered early press, and a hop when the key is let go; the held jump was used in the check run
height, time and falls in the top bar and the height bar down the left side
best height and best time are written to the browser's storage; reopening the game to read them back was not run
the finish shows time, falls and a code; the checker screen is evidence/code.png; making and reading codes was tested on four times and one forged code
two arrow buttons and a jump button are drawn and wired to touch; no check plays by touch
the sounds are made in code and called on jump, landing, a long fall and each rest floor; the check cannot hear them
the climb itself
stand-in: a finish code a viewer sends, and a screen that compares it with the streamer's best time
the climb starts on the garden floor at 0 m
zone 1's ledges are 5 and 4 columns wide; tap and hold give different heights
the ledges go from 5 columns to 4 at about 14 m; a miss lands on what is below, never a death
the first gold floor is at 30 m with a chime and a banner in the code; no run climbed that far to see it
a moving ledge is the second ledge above the first gold floor
zone 2 has two-column ledges and the first moving one; when a player gets there was not timed
nothing kills; gold floors about every 30 to 40 m catch any fall
crumbling, ice, wind, bouncers, belts and red bumpers each have a zone, and zone 10 mixes them (evidence/z10.png)
nobody has climbed it yet, so how long a first clear or a practised run takes is unknown
